result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but has one clear visual defect: the 'Popular right now' hero image failed to load and shows a broken-image placeholder. A few edge-truncation issues on the right side may also indicate layout or padding problems.

issues.description: The restaurant image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load, showing only a gray broken-image placeholder icon.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source URL or provide a branded fallback/placeholder image so the card doesn't look broken while loading or on failure.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' is hard-clipped at the screen edge with its title truncated ('Trattoria Piccol...') and no visible ellipsis or edge padding, making it look cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add right-edge padding/peek spacing or a fade gradient to signal horizontal scrollability, and truncate the title with an ellipsis.

issues.description: A category filter chip at the far right (after 'Healthy') is clipped to a thin sliver, appearing broken rather than partially visible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing or add a scroll affordance (fade/peek) so partially visible chips clearly indicate more content to the right.

issues.description: The pizza promo card at the bottom is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, with its content overlapping the viewport edge without spacing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient bottom padding on the scroll container so the last card isn't abruptly obscured by the tab bar.
